about: The fixed question set for SPEC.md acceptance criterion B4 (agent-aware). HELD OUT: an agent under test
is given the catalog endpoint and each entry's `question` — nothing else from this file, no SPEC, no README.
Its SQL is correct when it returns `expected`. `sql` is the reference answer, written against the README's
anonymous ATTACH (catalog alias `bioc`); tests/acceptance/test_live.py runs it to prove `expected` still
holds against the live catalog. Every `expected` was produced by running `sql` anonymously on 2026-09-18.
Answers are pinned to a release with `valid_from <= R AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > R)`, and to the
closed release 2026.08 wherever the source existed then. 2026.09 was still under construction when this
was written, so the questions pinned to it ask for facts a within-release correction is unlikely to move.
If one moves anyway, re-derive `expected` by running `sql`; do not loosen the comparison.
`expected` is a list of rows; row order is not significant.

questions.question: How many protein-coding genes did Ensembl annotate in the human genome as of biocOnIce release 2026.08?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bioc.annotation.gene
WHERE taxon_id = 9606 AND source = 'ENSEMBL' AND gene_type = 'protein_coding'
AND valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > '2026.08')

questions.question: Which Ensembl transcript is the canonical one for human BRCA2 in release 2026.08, and how many exons does it have?
sql: SELECT t.transcript_id, COUNT(*) AS exons
FROM bioc.annotation.gene g
JOIN bioc.annotation.transcript t USING (gene_id, taxon_id, source)
JOIN bioc.annotation.exon e USING (transcript_id, taxon_id, source)
WHERE g.symbol = 'BRCA2' AND g.taxon_id = 9606 AND g.source = 'ENSEMBL' AND t.canonical
AND g.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to > '2026.08')
AND t.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (t.valid_to IS NULL OR t.valid_to > '2026.08')
AND e.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to > '2026.08')
GROUP BY t.transcript_id

questions.question: Human BRCA1 is on the reverse strand. In release 2026.08, what are the chromosome, start and end (1-based, inclusive) of the first exon — the 5'-most in transcript order — of its canonical transcript?
questions.exercises: A1, B3 (coordinate convention; order by rank, not coordinate); annotation.exon
sql: SELECT e.sequence_name, e.start, e."end", e.strand
FROM bioc.annotation.gene g
JOIN bioc.annotation.transcript t USING (gene_id, taxon_id, source)
JOIN bioc.annotation.exon e USING (transcript_id, taxon_id, source)
WHERE g.symbol = 'BRCA1' AND g.taxon_id = 9606 AND g.source = 'ENSEMBL' AND t.canonical AND e.rank = 1
AND g.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to > '2026.08')
AND t.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (t.valid_to IS NULL OR t.valid_to > '2026.08')
AND e.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to > '2026.08')

questions.question: Which mouse genome assembly — name and GenBank assembly accession — do the Ensembl gene models of release 2026.08 sit on?
sql: SELECT assembly_name, genome_id FROM bioc.reference.genome
WHERE taxon_id = 10090 AND source = 'ENSEMBL'
AND valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > '2026.08')

questions.question: What is the OMIM number of the human gene CFTR, as of release 2026.08?
sql: SELECT m.target_id
FROM bioc.annotation.ncbi__gene g
JOIN bioc.annotation.identifier_mapping m
ON m.taxon_id = g.taxon_id AND m.source_namespace = 'ENTREZ' AND m.source_id = g.gene_id
WHERE g.symbol = 'CFTR' AND g.taxon_id = 9606 AND m.source = 'NCBI' AND m.target_namespace = 'OMIM'
AND g.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to > '2026.08')
AND m.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > '2026.08')

questions.question: An analysis run against release 2026.08 reports the human gene C17orf99. What is the official symbol of that same gene in release 2026.09?
questions.exercises: A1, A2 (point-in-time across two releases); annotation.ncbi__gene
sql: SELECT now.symbol
FROM bioc.annotation.ncbi__gene then_
JOIN bioc.annotation.ncbi__gene now USING (gene_id, taxon_id)
WHERE then_.symbol = 'C17orf99' AND then_.taxon_id = 9606
AND then_.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (then_.valid_to IS NULL OR then_.valid_to > '2026.08')
AND now.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (now.valid_to IS NULL OR now.valid_to > '2026.09')

questions.question: How many distinct GO molecular-function terms were directly annotated to the human insulin gene (INS) in release 2026.08?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.go_id)
FROM bioc.annotation.ncbi__gene g
JOIN bioc.annotation.ncbi__gene_go a USING (gene_id, taxon_id)
WHERE g.symbol = 'INS' AND g.taxon_id = 9606 AND a.category = 'Function'
AND g.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to > '2026.08')
AND a.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR a.valid_to > '2026.08')

questions.question: How many publications had NCBI linked to the human gene BRCA1 as of release 2026.08?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM bioc.annotation.ncbi__gene g
JOIN bioc.annotation.ncbi__gene_pubmed p USING (gene_id, taxon_id)
WHERE g.symbol = 'BRCA1' AND g.taxon_id = 9606
AND g.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to > '2026.08')
AND p.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (p.valid_to IS NULL OR p.valid_to > '2026.08')

questions.question: Of the publications NCBI linked to human XIST in release 2026.08, which one had the most citations in iCite's 2026-08 snapshot? Give its PMID and publication year.
questions.exercises: A1; annotation.ncbi__gene_pubmed joined to annotation.icite__metrics and annotation.icite__publication
sql: SELECT p.pubmed_id, pub.year
FROM bioc.annotation.ncbi__gene g
JOIN bioc.annotation.ncbi__gene_pubmed p USING (gene_id, taxon_id)
JOIN bioc.annotation.icite__metrics m ON m.pmid = p.pubmed_id AND m.snapshot = '2026-08'
JOIN bioc.annotation.icite__publication pub ON pub.pmid = p.pubmed_id
WHERE g.symbol = 'XIST' AND g.taxon_id = 9606
AND g.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to > '2026.08')
AND p.valid_from <= '2026.08' AND (p.valid_to IS NULL OR p.valid_to > '2026.08')
AND m.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > '2026.09')
AND pub.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (pub.valid_to IS NULL OR pub.valid_to > '2026.09')
ORDER BY m.citation_count DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: According to the Cell Ontology, is a hepatocyte a kind of epithelial cell?
questions.exercises: ontology.term, ontology.relationship (transitive is_a; terms imported into several ontologies)
sql: WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(term_id) AS (
SELECT term_id FROM bioc.ontology.term
WHERE ontology = 'cl' AND name = 'hepatocyte'
AND valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > '2026.09')
UNION
SELECT r.object_id FROM bioc.ontology.relationship r JOIN ancestors a ON r.subject_id = a.term_id
WHERE r.ontology = 'cl' AND r.predicate = 'is_a'
AND r.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > '2026.09')
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM ancestors a JOIN bioc.ontology.term t ON t.term_id = a.term_id
WHERE t.ontology = 'cl' AND t.name = 'epithelial cell'
AND t.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (t.valid_to IS NULL OR t.valid_to > '2026.09')

questions.question: In the Gene Ontology, what are the direct is_a parents of 'apoptotic process'? Give their names.
sql: SELECT parent.name
FROM bioc.ontology.term child
JOIN bioc.ontology.relationship r ON r.ontology = 'go' AND r.subject_id = child.term_id AND r.predicate = 'is_a'
JOIN bioc.ontology.term parent ON parent.ontology = 'go' AND parent.term_id = r.object_id
WHERE child.ontology = 'go' AND child.name = 'apoptotic process'
AND child.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (child.valid_to IS NULL OR child.valid_to > '2026.09')
AND r.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > '2026.09')
AND parent.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (parent.valid_to IS NULL OR parent.valid_to > '2026.09')

questions.question: Which assays, by name, produced the CELLxGENE dataset 'Tabula Sapiens - All Cells', and what DOI is its collection published under?
sql: SELECT t.name, ds.collection_doi
FROM bioc.resource.cellxgene__dataset ds
JOIN bioc.resource.resource_relationship rr
ON rr.resource_id = ds.dataset_version_id AND rr.relationship = 'has_assay' AND rr.source = 'cellxgene'
JOIN bioc.ontology.term t ON t.ontology = 'efo' AND t.term_id = rr.target_id
WHERE ds.title = 'Tabula Sapiens - All Cells'
AND ds.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (ds.valid_to IS NULL OR ds.valid_to > '2026.09')
AND rr.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (rr.valid_to IS NULL OR rr.valid_to > '2026.09')
AND t.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (t.valid_to IS NULL OR t.valid_to > '2026.09')

questions.question: How many BED files does BEDbase hold for GEO series GSE32970, and who is credited as the author of that set?
sql: SELECT bedfile_count, author FROM bioc.resource.bedbase__bedset
WHERE resource_id = 'gse32970'
AND valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > '2026.09')

questions.question: BEDbase has a BED file derived from ENCODE file ENCFF044KHD. Which genome is it on, which protein was targeted in which cell line, and which ENCODE experiment does it come from?
sql: SELECT f.genome_alias, f.target, f.cell_line, x.target_id
FROM bioc.resource.resource_relationship s
JOIN bioc.resource.bedbase__bedfile f ON f.resource_id = s.resource_id
JOIN bioc.resource.resource_relationship x
ON x.resource_id = s.resource_id AND x.relationship = 'derived_from_experiment' AND x.source = 'bedbase'
WHERE s.source = 'bedbase' AND s.relationship = 'derived_from_sample' AND lower(s.target_id) = 'encode:encff044khd'
AND x.target_id LIKE 'encode:%'
AND s.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (s.valid_to IS NULL OR s.valid_to > '2026.09')
AND x.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (x.valid_to IS NULL OR x.valid_to > '2026.09')
AND f.valid_from <= '2026.09' AND (f.valid_to IS NULL OR f.valid_to > '2026.09')

questions.question: Which Ensembl release and which NCBI Gene download date was biocOnIce release 2026.08 built from?
sql: SELECT source, source_version FROM bioc.provenance.release
WHERE release = '2026.08' AND source IN ('ensembl', 'ncbi_gene')
